findings.claim: Policy diagnostics do not follow the spec-6 shape `<file>:<line>: policy(<mode>): rule <id> added|modified|removed outside <detail>` with a Why naming the base ref: the gated verifier diagnostic drops the added/modified action, the strict diagnostic drops the `outside <detail>` form, and Why is a fixed string that never names the base ref.
findings.failure_scenario: Gated target repo, agent branch adds `//acdsl:ACDSL-GOLANG-X-001 newverifier ...` (GOLANG editable, newverifier not in the base registry) -> acdsl check prints `acdsl/rules.acdsl:N: policy(gated): rule ACDSL-GOLANG-X-001 binds verifier "newverifier" outside the sanctioned set` with Why `... sanction the change on the policy base branch, or revert` — no `added`, no base ref name; strict mode prints `rule <id> added — no rule is editable in this repo` instead of `added outside <detail>`.
findings.fix: Render every rule diagnostic as `policy(<mode>): rule <id> <action> outside <detail>` (pass action into the verifier branch: `rule %s %s outside the sanctioned verifier set (%q)`, strict: `rule %s %s outside the editable set (strict: none)`) and build Why from the resolved base ref: `sanction the scope in acdsl/policy.json on <base>, or revert`.
findings.evidence: Re-read git show 1f725ce:internal/acdsl/policy.go lines 82-109 (classViolations: strict message L93 `rule %s %s — no rule is editable in this repo`, verifier message L105 `rule %s binds verifier %q outside the sanctioned set` without the action argument) and L223-231 (policyDiagnostic: Why is the constant `acdsl/policy.json governs who may change the rule system — sanction the change on the policy base branch, or revert`, no base parameter). Spec-6 raw.md L256 mandates Message `<file>:<line>: policy(<mode>): rule <id> added|modified|removed outside <detail>` and Why naming the fix `sanction the scope in acdsl/policy.json on <base ref>, or revert`; the spec's Hot items contain no alternative strings (grep found none), so L256 is the only contract. Not in known.json (no entry on diagnostic shape).
